raw.source: US BIS - Department of Commerce Rescinds Biden-Era Firearms Rule, Restoring Common Sense to Export Controls on Civilian Firearms
raw.content_en: The US Department of Commerce (BIS) has rescinded the Biden-era firearms rule, restoring prior export control treatment for civilian firearms, ammunition, and related parts under the EAR. This reduces licensing burdens for certain civilian firearm exports but does not eliminate all controls: items may still fall under the USML (ITAR) or EAR-controlled categories, and end-user/end-use restrictions, embargoed destinations, and Entity List screening remain mandatory. Exporters must re-verify ECCN classification, license exceptions, and destination-based prohibitions before shipment.
raw.content_zh: 美国商务部（BIS）撤销了拜登时期的枪支出口规则，恢复了对民用枪支、弹药及相关零部件在《出口管理条例》（EAR）下的原有出口管制待遇。此举降低了部分民用枪支出口的许可负担，但并未取消全部管制：相关物项仍可能属于USML（ITAR）或EAR管制类别，最终用户/最终用途限制、禁运目的地及实体清单筛查仍为强制要求。出口商在发运前必须重新核实ECCN分类、许可例外及基于目的地的禁令。

checklist.desc: Re-classify firearms, ammunition, and parts under the revised EAR to confirm ECCN and whether any item remains USML/ITAR-controlled; document classification rationale.

checklist.task: 许可例外与目的地筛查
checklist.desc: Verify eligibility for license exceptions and screen the destination against embargoed countries and BIS restricted party lists before export.

checklist.task: 最终用户/最终用途声明
checklist.desc: Obtain and retain end-user and end-use statements; confirm no diversion to prohibited military or sanctioned end uses.

checklist.task: HTS 与 Section 301 关税映射
checklist.desc: Map the 10-digit HTS line against Section 301 lists and additional duties; document country of origin and value build-up.

checklist.task: FCC Part 15/18 合规（含电子配件）
checklist.desc: For electronic sights, optics, or RF accessories, confirm FCC Part 15/18 conformity and supplier FCC IDs before US entry.

checklist.task: Entity List 与受限方筛查
checklist.desc: Run restricted party and Entity List screening; retain screening records and export license determinations for audit.
